title: 第9章 猎杀妖兽阴谋将至第10章 炼体六重来者不善
content_zh:
天断山中妖兽横行，叶无尘两人也只敢在外围游荡。
不久后，两人躲在一棵大树底下，在他们的前方，一只妖猴正在抱着香蕉大快朵颐。
妖猴全身毛发雪白，体型比一般的成年男子还要高大不少，四肢颇为发达，身上的肌肉充满着暴力之感。
“白面妖猴，炼体五重的妖兽。”
叶无尘看着面前的妖兽，跃跃欲试。
只见他一步迈出，身体如猎豹一般冲向白面妖猴。
那妖猴还在美美的吃着香蕉，直到叶无尘的拳头离它已经近在咫尺了才反应过来，但此时已然为时已晚。
势大力沉的一拳结结实实的砸在了白面妖猴的后背之上，发出一道沉闷的碰撞声。
伴随着惨叫声传出，妖猴狠狠的撞在一旁的大树上，激起无数飞鸟与落叶。
紧接着，妖猴没有丝毫犹豫，直接调转身形朝远处开始逃跑了起来。
“小月，给我拦住他，别让它跑了。”
接到指示，叶夕月从暗处冲出，直接挡在了妖猴的逃跑路线之上。
此时两人一前一后将妖猴包围在中间，妖猴若是想朝左右逃跑，必定会遭受两人的围攻。
如今的局面，它只能选择朝叶夕月或者叶无尘的方向突围。
被围在中间的妖猴不停转头看向两人，似乎是在分析往哪边突围更为安全。
最终，白面妖猴怒吼一声，调转身形朝叶无尘冲去。
在它看来，身后少年的气息明显要比那少女的气息弱上不少。
见到妖猴朝自己冲来，叶无尘脚尖一点地面，身体如离弦之箭一般同样朝妖猴冲去。
就当叶无尘的拳头马上就要落到妖猴身上的时候。
那妖猴竟朝后退了一步，让叶无尘的这一拳落在了空处。

“好狡猾的妖兽。”
叶无尘暗道一声，不过这也在他的预料之中。
妖兽生性愚笨，但灵长类妖兽的智商会比一般的妖兽高出许多。
特别是猴子一类的妖兽，其智商不见得会比人类低上多少。
在躲开叶无尘的攻击之后，那妖猴脚下用力一蹬，身形仿佛化作闪电一般朝叶无尘袭来。
面对妖猴的攻击，叶无尘却是没有选择闪躲。
只见他身上的气血开始翻涌，伴随着轰鸣之声，叶无尘的拳头与妖猴的拳头碰撞在了一起。
一声闷响过后，叶无尘依旧站立原地，反观那妖猴，却是倒退了数步。
一般情况下，妖兽的肉身都会比同境界的人族武者要强横不少。
但叶无尘却凭借着炼体三重的实力正面击退了炼体五重的妖猴。
这足以证明现在的叶无尘肉身力量究竟有多么恐怖。
白面妖猴见到自己竟然被一个弱小的人类武者从正面击退，眼中不由得露出了一抹人性化的愤怒。
只见它怒吼一声，再次狂奔着朝叶无尘冲去。
“来的好！”
叶无尘丝毫不惧，同样朝对方冲去。
两人对轰数拳，叶无尘越战越勇，气血奔腾不止。
那妖猴则是越来越愤怒，两人的拳头不断碰撞在一起。
此时若是有不知道内情的人出现在此地，还以为这是两只妖兽在打架呢。
然而，就在妖猴又是一拳轰出之时。
叶无尘只感觉身后传来了强烈的危机感，身体本能的朝一旁迈出一步。

与此同时，他的身后，一只妖兽的拳头出现在刚刚他所在的位置。
content_en:
Demonic beasts were rampant in Tianduan Mountain, and Ye Wuchen and the others only dared to wander around the periphery.
Soon after, the two hid under a big tree. In front of them, a demon monkey was holding a banana and feasting on it.
The demon monkey has snow-white hair all over its body, and is much taller than an average adult man. Its limbs are quite developed, and the muscles on its body are full of violence.
"The white-faced demon monkey, a demon beast at the fifth level of body refining."
Ye Wuchen looked at the monster in front of him, eager to try.
He took one step forward and rushed toward the white-faced demon monkey like a cheetah.
The demon monkey was still eating the banana happily, and it didn't react until Ye Wuchen's fist was very close to it, but by this time it was already too late.
A powerful and heavy punch hit the white-faced demon monkey's back firmly, making a dull collision sound.
Along with the screams, the demon monkey slammed into the big tree nearby, stirring up countless birds and fallen leaves.
Immediately afterwards, the demon monkey turned around without any hesitation and started running away into the distance.
"Xiaoyue, stop him, don't let him run away."
After receiving the instruction, Ye Xiyue rushed out from the darkness and directly blocked the demon monkey's escape route.
At this time, the two people surrounded the demon monkey in the middle. If the demon monkey wanted to escape to the left and right, it would definitely be besieged by the two men.
In the current situation, it could only choose to break out in the direction of Ye Xiyue or Ye Wuchen.
The demon monkey surrounded in the middle kept turning his head to look at the two people, as if he was analyzing which way would be safer to break out of the encirclement.
Finally, the white-faced demon monkey roared, turned around and rushed towards Ye Wuchen.
In its view, the aura of the boy behind him was obviously much weaker than that of the girl.
Seeing the demon monkey rushing towards him, Ye Wuchen touched the ground with his toes and rushed towards the demon monkey like an arrow from a string.
Just when Ye Wuchen's fist was about to fall on the demon monkey.
The demon monkey actually took a step back, letting Ye Wuchen's punch fall into the air.
"What a cunning monster."
Ye Wuchen secretly thought, but this was also what he expected.
Monsters are stupid by nature, but the IQ of primate monsters is much higher than that of ordinary monsters.
Especially for monsters like monkeys, their IQ is not necessarily much lower than that of humans.
After dodging Ye Wuchen's attack, the demon monkey kicked his feet hard, and his body seemed to turn into lightning and attack Ye Wuchen.
Facing the demon monkey's attack, Ye Wuchen did not choose to dodge.
The energy and blood in his body began to surge, and with a roaring sound, Ye Wuchen's fist collided with the monster monkey's fist.
After a muffled sound, Ye Wuchen still stood where he was. On the other hand, the demon monkey took a few steps back.
Under normal circumstances, the physical bodies of monster beasts are much more powerful than human warriors of the same realm.
But Ye Wuchen relied on his strength at the third level of body refining to defeat the monster monkey at the fifth level of body refining head-on.
This is enough to prove how terrifying Ye Wuchen's current physical strength is.
When the white-faced demon monkey saw that he was being repelled from the front by a weak human warrior, he couldn't help but reveal a hint of human anger in his eyes.
It roared angrily and rushed toward Ye Wuchen again.
"Well done!"
Ye Wuchen was not afraid at all and rushed towards the opponent as well.
The two of them exchanged several punches, and Ye Wuchen became more and more courageous as he fought, his energy and blood flowing rapidly.
The demon monkey became more and more angry, and their fists kept colliding with each other.
If someone who didn't know the inside story appeared here at this time, they would think it was two monsters fighting.
However, just when the demon monkey punched out again.
Ye Wuchen only felt a strong sense of crisis coming from behind him, and his body instinctively took a step to the side.
At the same time, behind him, the fist of a monster beast appeared where he was just now.
